title: Individual lifts of generated abelian sections on a stage cover
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $P_j$ precoverages [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and $V$ a cocone whose object and arrow set cocones are colimiting [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Assume each $P_j$-cover has finitely many arrows, transition functors map covers to covers and are continuous, and $Q$ is a precoverage on $V.pt$ whose covers are exactly transported images of stage covers. Assume the cocone functors are continuous. Fix $i$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $A_t=F(t.hom)^{-1}G$ and $H=V_i^{-1}G$. Let $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^*H$ have composites with the stage units equal, componentwise as arrows, to the $V_i$ unit. Let $B$ be the subgroup-generated presheaf of restrictions of stage images [def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-stage-image]. For an object $Y$, a covering presieve $R\in Q(Y)$ and any family $x$ of $B$-sections on $R$ (with no compatibility assumption), there exist $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $W\in F(t.right)$, $T\in P_{t.right}(W)$, $h:V_tW=Y$, and a family $y$ of $A_t$-sections on $T$ such that $V_t(g)\circ h$ lies in $R$ and $\alpha_t(y_g)=x_{V_t(g)\circ h}$ as an underlying $H$-section. No compatibility of $y$ or amalgamation is asserted; no finite closure or covering-pullback axiom is assumed.

proof.text: Present R by a stage covering presieve using hQ. Use a common stage of i and this stage, transport the presieve by hcover, and evaluate cocone naturality on its target. The private cover_above lemma proves that its transported cocone image is exactly R; map_comp_presieve and transported_map_presieve justify the presieve equation.

The stage presieve T0 has a finite uncurry type by hfinite. Index its source objects and the given image-family sections by this type. Apply the proved finite-object section-lift theorem to obtain a refinement in Under i and representatives over all forward source images simultaneously.

Map T0 by the refinement functor. It remains covering by hcover. Evaluate V.w on W0 for the target equality; transported_map_presieve and transport_presieve_mem show every image arrow belongs to R. For each actual member of this image presieve, eliminate its map membership in a Prop-valued existence proof to obtain a representative. Functor.congr_hom gives the arrow transport formula. family_transport proves transport of the original section, and family_congr identifies values at equal arrows, without any compatibility hypothesis. Classical choice selects one section per actual member; duplicate representatives are harmless. Return the stage cover, target equality, membership map, section family and image equations.

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_site_abelian_cover_section_lift
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y) (hR : R ∈ Q Y)
    (x : R.FamilyOfElements
      (ColimitSiteStageImage.presheaf F P V Q i G α ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})) :
    ∃ (t : Under i) (W : F.obj t.right) (T : Presieve W), T ∈ P t.right W ∧
      ∃ (hY : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj W = Y)
        (hTR : ∀ {Z : F.obj t.right} (g : Z ⟶ W), T g →
          R ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map g ≫ eqToHom hY))
        (y : T.FamilyOfElements
          (((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⋙
              forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})),
        ∀ {Z : F.obj t.right} (g : Z ⟶ W) (hg : T g),
          (α t).hom.app (op Z) (y g hg) =
            (x ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.map g ≫ eqToHom hY) (hTR g hg)).val
